newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon construction activity down in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon construction activity down in Jan.

text.p: Construction activity in Lebanon continued a downward trend in January, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin issued on Wednesday.
"Construction performance continued to trend down with slower investment and demand," the bank said.
Cement deliveries fell to 239 thousand tonnes in January, declining by 18.6 percent compared to December while increasing 11.6 percent on a year-on-year basis.
The report said the area of construction permits approved in January by the Association of Engineers declined by 33.2 percent over the same period in 1996.
However, total real estate fees collected increased by 31.6 percent on a year-to-year basis to reach 17.1 billion pounds in January, the report added.
($1 = 1,549.75 Lebanese pounds at end of December 1996)
